reviews.comment: Actually the worst class Ive ever taken. The assignments feel like a waste of time and are super long for no reason. The questions and lectures dont make any sense.. and there is SO MUCH PACKBACK. He is super picky over the smallest things DO NOT TAKE

Do NOT take this class if you don't need to. Day grades are due, he goes in and changes all group assignments we got an A on, to a B. He genuinely does not want anyone to get an A in the class. Went this whole semester not knowing my overall grade either. One of the WORST professors I have ever had. He is ruining my 4.0 for the semester.
Way too much unnecessary work for a creative arts course. Did more work for this course than any of my core classes. DO NOT TAKE.

The course makes no sense.  There is so many pack backs due every Sunday.  The instructions for individual and team assignments literally make no sense and are so long for no reason. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS!

Is devoid of any teaching ability. Grading has zero consistency and he offers no explanation for your project scores. Switched his attendance policy mid semester (against TAMU protocol). Projects are incredibly confusing and the instructions will even contradict themselves on occasion. Do not take ENDS with this guy, it is not worth it.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM. Rude, doesn't respond kindly or helpfully to emails, instructions make no sense and every assignment has like 30 pages, and his grading doesn't make sense. His assignments are so weird, and he makes them difficult for no reason. 4 packback questions and 4 responses per week. Materials are never posted on time

The professor is very knowledgeable, but the class itself is poorly designed. Do all Packbacks (just reach the 60 points) and get an 85 on the projects should be an A, for projects an 85 meets expectations and a 100 is basically unattainable. If your final grade seems off, email him, he miscalculated my grade and fixed it after I emailed him.

All the bad reviews he will eventually get taken. Worst professor you will ever have. If you like random grades and a class that is based on fictional ideas, you would love this class. He doesn't communicate, and his rubric looks like something from a second-grade class. His instructions are pages of nonsense. Every grade is a toss-up.

BIGGEST waste of time. I ignored rate my professor, figured it would be fine. DO NOT DO THIS. Spent every Sunday night doing 8 120+ word responses on packback and HOURS doing projects unrelated to the lectures. Also, the grading rubric is the biggest JOKE I have ever seen (can not emphasize this enough). Grades are hidden still and its finals week.

ENDS 101 isn't hard, but the instructions are confusing and overly lengthy. There are lots of Packback assignments due every Sunday (4 questions and 4 responses). Group projects depend heavily on your team ( you have the same group for 3 assignments). ALSO, he locks grades for the entire semester, so you can't track your actual score...
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: (ENDS 101) This was one of the worst classes I have taken. I needed to take a creative arts course, and this was the only one left available. You will have group projects and individual assignments, the instructions for which are far too long and overcomplicated. Packback is lecture-heavy and takes too much time. DO NOT RECOMMEND EVER

Do not take this professor, there is a reason he has a 1.8 rating. Responds to emails but is very unhelpful. Gives a grading rubric, it does absolutely nothing, you can get an 85 for "meeting expectations". Attendance not mandatory, sometimes gave extra credit for it, lowest attendance was 7/100, sounds like an old man complaining during lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This dude sucks so bad I hate him. He's rude, doesn't make any sense in his emails or instructions, and his grading makes no sense. I hate him and this class so much I'm writing a second review 6 months later be
The lectures were very confusing and hard to follow. The assignments were easy, but took a long time to complete.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's not that bad. 50% of the work is group projects, theres weekly packback assignments and individual projects that make up the other 50% of your grade. His grading just isn't clear but if you put in a good amount of effort you'll end up with an a in the class. He responds to emails quickly.

Assignments are SO time consuming and his written directions seem like he is trying to meet a minimum word limit. Lectures come off like a pseudo intellectual self help book rather than meaningfully teaching students to be creative. Instead of teaching any fundamentals, everything is business oriented and basically prepares you to be on shark tank

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Assignment instructions are so cryptic they genuinely make no sense. It reminds me of that Noah Centineo speech iykyk. You have to do 8 pack backs a WEEK, and did I mention how unnecessarily hard the projects are? Take anything else I would not recommend to anyone.

Do anything BUT take this class for creative arts! He randomly took attendance of 20 students each class and if you were absent that one day you get a 0 for attendance grade. The lectures had nothing to do with the assignments. The assignments will take HOURS out of your life and he does not believe that following rubric means you earn a 100! AWFUL

Very demeaning and unapproachable. When I met with him for office hours, he would constantly put me down as a student, telling me that I was not "creative" enough for the career I wanted. When I showed him the places in my assignment that he penalized, he would still find random things to nitpick about them to justify his flawed grading system.

Atrociously disorganized course, completely subjective and unclear grading criteria, useless busywork passed off as "life-changing leadership development", incredibly dismissive of complaints, shows superiority complex by deflecting blame onto students. I have nothing positive to say about the guy, I gained literally nothing from taking his course.

Don't take this prof. like this class was supposed to be some random blowoff, and while it was light work I had so much other stuff to do and his pointless 5 page assignments never helped. Also yeah he's kind of a wall when you message him.

I emailed this prof asking a question on something unclear. He emailed back on the defensive claiming I said he penalized students. Where he got that from, I don't know. Did he answer my question? No. He's extremely defensive anytime you ask him a question on his confusing grading criteria (or something else) and doesn't give anything above 85.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly this class was fun, I got to be creative with the assignments given. When it comes to grading, he wants effort and wants to be wowed. He's a good prof, I will say when it comes to emailing/talking to him, it's like talking to a brick wall. He likes to be fair, if someone is not cooperating you can fire them, so it won't impact your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I though that people were just being dramatic on his ratings but he's horrible. Like people are saying the grading is some what random and he will give you a 75 for doing what the rubric says. Take any other professor but him.

Difficult class, would not in good faith recommend this course. Project grades are pretty much randomly assigned with 0 feedback as to what you could have done better. Please take literally anything else for a core creative arts credit.

I took this class online, and the professor gives two one-hour lectures weekly. These lectures have nothing to do with the assignments and are wasted hours of life that you will never get back. There is no structure, and most of the content is made up. The grades are practically decided by TAs picking random numbers out of a hat. Avoid at all costs
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want to do an ungodly amount of work on a UCC just to receive an 80, this is the perfect class for you.  Have a GPA-bound scholarship that you don't want anymore?  This is the class for you. I don't have a single clue why this is a class in the first place.  Save yourself the frustration of this class, and take anyone BUT Dr. Vanegas!

Avoid Dr. Vanegas for ENDS 101 no matter what. The base grade for doing what the rubric asks of an assignment is a 75. From there, it is left up to the TA's and Professor to determine your grade.  Thus, the assignments are graded on what they "feel" it deserves. Coming from a 4.0 STEM student, this class is just ridiculous for a UCC credit.

I have never hated (and I mean HATE) a professor more. Tough grading on intangible things such as an elevator pitch to an animal. You can't even get above an 85. I'm going to get a B in a 100 level creative arts class. That is actually insane. I can feel my ears boiling just talking about him. He needs to be suspended from his job. DON'T TAKE HIM.

Worst professor I have ever had in college. I cannot believe this class is an option at Texas A&M. He gives the strangest assignments, which involve inventing things, making superheroes, and creating new animals. The catch is that no matter how much work you put in, you can never get above a 90 on one of the projects and usually get an 80 or 85.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was extremely frustrating and way to much work. Projects are dumb and graded really hard. You are graded on creativity and "wow factor" so nothing tangible. I heard this class was easy with other teachers but would not recommend this one.
READ ALL OF THE OTHER REVIEWS! If you dont care about your grade get him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: For the love of all things green and good, choose a different class for your creative arts!!! it is NOT worth it. If you must take this class, try to get a different prof. Unless you love difficult to read rubrics and slide shows and super harsh and unfair grading, stay away.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Taking this course made me reevaulate my life and not in a good way.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are thinking of taking this class because it "can't be that bad", think again. This class was the worst class I have taken. All the assignments are projects that are insanely long and confusing to complete. I spent about 6 hours per project just to get 90's. He is rude when you ask for help and insists his rubrics are clear.

I did more work for this class than my 300 level stem courses. Project instructions are horribly long, confusing, and an eye sore of highlighting. Then, even if you follow them and try hard to "be more creative," you're getting an 80-90 at BEST. Don't even get me started on the Jason Silva videos. I almost Q dropped just to end the pain

This guy is the worst. Everything he posts is super wordy and confusing and when you email for clarification he's rude and unhelpful. This class was projects and packbacks (4 questions 4 responses per week). The projects are really long and the instructions are like 15 pages of confusion. Also if you just follow the instructions you get a 75.

Needs to be behind bars. This class is so disorganized and time consuming with all the projects (that are graded INSANELY hard). Barely even know what to do on assignments bc the instructions aren't clear and SO disorganized. This class should be an easy A and it's not. DO NOT TAKE if you want to live.

This is one of the worst classes that I have ever taken. If I could give this prof a zero I would do it. I had to do all of the group projects by myself because he assigns random groups, when I went to talk to him about my group not caring about anything, all he had to say was "reach out to them". Which was something that I had obviously done.

Worst prof I've ever had. Most ridiculous grading I have ever seen. Gives 70s if an assignment isn't "forgettable or unique enough". People emailed concerned about how low of grades he was giving, this was his direct response via email "this is NOT a grade-driven course, but rather an overall learning experience-driven course"

The worst professor I've ever had. You can spend hours on a project and meet all the requirements and he will still say it's "not creative enough." And don't email him, his responses are so rude. He expects way to much for a 100 level class. I will be reporting him to the university and trying to get him to no longer teach this class.

There is 0 reason why I should be spending as much time on this class than I do my engineering classes. He's an ok guy but really needs to learn his place, I can't speak for comms majors but us engineers have bigger and better things to worry about.
He's demanding way too much for a 100 level course
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: guys yall doing too much for the comments  he cool he just wants u too do more  and work harder just be good and youll have a fun time

Professor is not a BAD professor, his class is just sort of made up. I think he was nice and didn't have a problem with him, the reviews are being a little mean. Take the class for an EASY but slightly TEDIOUS A. There is no reason why you can't get an A. Projects were easy, hw have extra credit, and final wasn't a big commitment.

honestly, just an old guy like complains about the current state of education. I am not kidding when I say all he does is read exactly what is on the slides, and he makes up his own ideas for creative thinking and gives you quizzes on it. it's all made up, so if you don't understand something, you are kind of screwed. so easy, but don't do it.

Professor Vanegas is a nice guy and very passionate about ENDS 101, but the class is insanely boring. The lectures have absolutely nothing to do with any of the assignments. There are weekly "quizzes" and 4-5 actual assignments. The class takes up too much time for being an elective. Would not recommend at all.

This is the worst professor I've ever had. I can barely even put into words how much I hated being in this class. The amount of work assigned vs. what you get out of the course is appalling. Do yourself a favor and get into the other section.

Legit dropped the class on the first day because of how much work he was assigned. Not a class if you want an easy A, lots of work, projects that will probably take more time than your actual classes that go towards your major. Do Not Take if you don't want to be overwhelmed!
Don't take this professor. Really easy but way too much busy work for a 101 class. Avoid this professor at all cost.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor's assignments had confusing instructions that took time to interpret and lectures were very dull. 2 individual and 3 group projects that were graded leniently (that is, when I took the course). Weekly 'quizzes' which were meant to give feedback on lectures. Overall, kinda easy, but time-consuming A+. Can't say I'd recommend though.

The lectures are very boring but you can tell professor Vanegas is passionate about it. There are few assignments with unclear instructions. You do not learn anything in lecture pertaining to the class. A total of 5 individual assignments and 5 group assignments. If you don't like group work, I wouldn't reccomened but overall really easy.

Lectures are boring and have no relevance. Only projects and group projects. Instructions are awful and so incredibly difficult to understand.  Assignments take a long time. Available to ask questions but never answers them well. Overall though He's been an easy grader and hands out extra credit. Doable class but would not recommend doing it.

I am so serious when I say I have never hated a class more than ENDS 101. Lectures consist of over 100 slides with no relevance to the material. The projects that are assigned are confusing with very odd formatting of instructions. He answers to emails very quickly, but never gives real help. Took as an elective and easily became the hardest class.

I don't think I've hated a class more than ENDS101. His lectures are completely pointless. He doesn't grade anything himself. You'll hear that he was the dean of architecture at least a million class. If you take this class, please do not take this professor. Your academic life will be MUCH less stressful.

Horribly taught class. Lectures are so meaningless and convoluted. Assignments aren't necessarily hard they can just take a while. If the TA that grades your assignments is harsh they can give you any grade they want with almost zero feedback. Definitely possible to get an A in the class just be ready to give up your pride to please almighty Dr. V.

Only like 5 assignments the entire semester, all of which you can put around 1 hour into doing. There are group assignments but they are very easy. You don't need to attend the class, although he does encourage going. Very easy creative arts credit.

Do not take this professor if you are looking for an easy A. An 80 is considered doing assignments well and to get above an 80 you have to go "above and beyond"- but who knows what that means because his rubrics are impossible to understand. The online class section still forces you to meet in person with your team which is a pain.

Taking this class was the worst decision of my life. Do NOT take this class if you expect an easy A. I'm an engineering major, and this elective ironically gave me the most stress the entire semester. The grading criterias are not clear with unreasonable expectations. Instructions are as unintelligible. Lectures are boring and unhelpful.

hi people this man right here is very good and a lot of yall say he is rude no he tries not to baby yall and he's sweet kind amazing and handsome he is my dad and he is very good at two jobs being there for me and teaching others how to be brilliant so can yall be nice and ill be nice to and he's funny I hope you have a great day good bye.

Absolutely horrible experience in his online class. We receive poor grades and absolutely no feedback. His class works by posting a long lecture video then putting thousands of slides in which he spends countless years talking about. He indeed also has a sense of pride which he makes clear by making others feel smaller than him; poor actions.

I enjoyed ENDS 101. Dr. Vanegas is very passionate about what he teaches and encourages students to be bold and try new things. The assignments are not difficult, so if you're just looking for an easy grade you can get it. However, I felt that it was worth the time and effort to listen to the lectures and actually take assignments seriously.
Dr. V goes on long rants which can seem to be pointless at times, but I can honestly say that at the end of this class I had learned a lot on how to live a better life.

lol u do not need to show up to class at all he might have an attendance qr code but he doesnt check it. do the bare minimum, turn in ur stuff on time and u will get an A no problem. yes this class has nothing to do with ur actual major but u gotta do what u gotta do. class is sometimes cool usually boring but honestly group projects were fun

He thinks his lectures are a lot more interesting than they are, but the class itself is incredibly easy. Just read the syllabus at the beginning of the year and do the bare minimum for the assignments. For grading -- when I took the class the TA's graded it so it was pretty lenient.

The critique about Prof. V mentioning he's the Dean of the School of Architecture every class is true, but he kind of deserves to be proud about it given that it's TAMU! If you're capable of the complicated task of breathing, and are willing to put forth a modicum of effort you'll get an A in this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Class is not that hard but the lectures are incredibly boring. Hard to understand, but if you do just a little more than he asks he will reward you.
Very interesting lectures with lots of good info but confusing
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Group projects--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was honestly really easy. Professor Vanegas is alright and sometimes boring but it doesn't matter cause his class is easy. Very subjective. The individual assignments are manageable as long as you put in the work and same for the group projects. Don't trip, this class is easy and he is not awful at all.

It wasnt a hard class. Just a very boring and repetitive one. Youll be fine as long as you do the work. Once you decipher the over detailed instructions for assignments it gets easier. I cant tell you how manny times you hear the words creativity and innovation so be prepared for that.
Honestly an easy course. The people complaining are wrong.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Once you learn what he wants from your assignments, the class is an easy A. You just have to think of something original; something he hasn't seen before, write something unique and he will applaud you. However, it took me a while to figure that out, so I ended up with a B. Originality and creativity is what he wants, you have to wow him for an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Vanegas is the dean of the architecture department and he'll make sure to remind the class of that every single lecture. He thinks far too highly of this course and has made it way more demanding than it ought to be. The lectures don't matter, and there are no tests or quizzes, but there are a number of projects that take a LOT of time.
Absolutely awful class! Most time consuming class I have every taken.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Material is all very confusing. Grading is unclear and very poor. And overall is just not a good class to take. I took it thinking it would be interesting and not too difficult but was very wrong. Find anything else.

This was the literal worst class i have ever taken in my life. For a creative arts class there were more rules and regulations and completely irrelevant guidelines than i have ever had in any other class. DO NOT take this class, seriously, don't. The TAs are not helpful, and if your creativity isn't their idea of it then you can kiss that A goodbye

So boring. I really feel like he just likes to hear himself talk. He once asked in class "Have you ever had a teacher who you thought made an otherwise good class boring or uninteresting?" and the class GroupMe lit up with everybody saying "he just described his own class" so I know I'm not alone in feeling this. I was excited for this class too :/

This professor will waste your time the entire semester. Every lecture he'd spend 15 minutes talking about the class rules. He constantly complained that students did not engage in class, but the lectures cover too much material too quickly and are hard to keep up with. The assignments are not hard, just tedious, and unrelatable to lectures.

Lectures are boring, 40% of grade is group projects. No feedback on projects unless you go to talk to TAs. hidden bonus points from odd expectations that were never verbalized. Not an easy A at all. If you take it visit TAs, go to office hours, post in discussions. Also there were a few random attendance checks.

I can say without a doubt that this class was not worth the effort that I had to put into it. It is definitely not an easy A. Every lectures is dull and uninspiring and every document he puts out from assignment instructions and lectures to the syllabus is confusing and hard to read thanks to the overuse of highlighting, bold, and underlined text.

Uses words beyond his vocabulary. Lectures are very boring and pointless. Lots of work outside of class. Busy work is outrageous. Do not take this class if you are not interested in creativity. Class is pointless.

Although an A is certainly achievable for this class, there is an excessive amount of group/individual projects that take up a lot of time. Instructions to these projects are also super vague and wordy, and doing anything in this class just made me realize how much I hated having to use a "creative imagination" and work with groups. Never again.
Lectures were very boring and mostly just random quotes from famous people. The homework was very confusing and the directions only made it worse. Pretty easy class but not worth the frustration.

This class isn't necessarily hard, but it requires an unnecessary amount of time (7 projects and 10 weekly reports). You are graded based on your creativity (which is subjective), so if you submit something that isn't the best idea he's ever seen, don't expect to get an A on that project. I would NOT take this class again.

A classmate told me to not take this class, I should of listened! I enjoy some content that was explored, but the amount of time I spend on his assignments consumes WAY TOO MUCH of my time considering I work and have 4 other classes!! He asks a little too much from students, considering this is not a very important class in the first place.

Do not take ENDS101 online. His grading criteria is very unclear, his lectures are very scattered and difficult to read with all the different fonts he uses, and some of the lectures are just random and don't pertain to the subject. He also gets extremely annoyed the two times I tried to schedule a meeting with him, and the TAs were unavailable.

I took this class because I heard it was supposed to be easy, but it was not. He gives very dumb assignments in which you have to express yourself creatively, but if you do everything perfectly you can only get an 80. You have to go above and beyond what they ask to do any better and no one tells you that so you just get bad grades for no reason.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The content of ENDS 101 was interesting. However Dr. Vanegas is confusing and unclear in his expectations. There are not any tests but several group and individual projects. The Co-Instructor Mr. Billingsley and the TAs were very helpful and nice. However I would NOT take this class again. This is NOT an easy A at all, you will have to work for it!
He makes two pages of instructions clearly detailing exactly what he expects you to do and it's the same format every single time. Getting an A is not effortless, but definitely attainable

This class is often taken for the "easy A", and while it is very possible to get a good grade in this class, you have to work for it.  Expect weekly written reports(100/0) Also there will be longer Individual and team projects(about 6hr+). Don't leave it for last minute, it's so obvious when you do. Also, note that half of the class is online.

Beginning: interesting, cool, as semester progresses, becomes HIGHLY repetitive, he will say "it's relevant, that's why he repeats it". He reads his PowerPoint slides .99 VERBATIM. Love idea o' class, enjoyed all but repetitiveness and WAY too much info and graphs. Lost inspiration bc of these killers. Info need simplified and foster inspiration.

Unless you have to take this class, do not take it. If you have to though, do not take Dr. Jorge Vanegas. He makes it really hard and time consuming. You have to be creative & WOW him to get an A. The instructions for the assignments are long & don't make sense. I got 18/20 on one because the thought the colors I used were not CATCHY! Really?

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS #2: You really have to "wow" him to get an minimum grade on any project. He pretend to grades off of creativity and innovation, which is something very subjective, and he has no taste at all. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!

There are group projects in which you have to meet with others outside of class. VERY unspecific on assignments so students use their own interpretation and creativity. The help I got from the TAs was usually useless. I liked the class, it was eye opening and interesting but a lot of work.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! Every day you recieve multiple eCampus notifications form this class, assignments have a minimum of 2 pages of instructions that take forever to read, decode, and understand, lectures are long and pointless, and assignments themselves are tedious and stupid. Basically it is the worst class you can possibly take here at A&M.

I would not take this class unless it is absolutely necessary. You can achieve an A but it will take a lot of work. The class consists of an overload of easy assignments and it can be easy to fall behind.

This was the worst class I have ever taken. I would not recommend it to my worst enemy. The lectures were long and pointless. All of the work you do comes with at least 2 pages full of detailed instructions that make no sense. None of the work has any meaning whatsoever and seems to be made up. AVOID THIS CLASS AND THIS PROFESSOR!

This bro took a lesson from the US tax code on complexity. Everything you will ever receive from him is unnecessarily wordy. A simple assignment of watching an online video and giving feedback on it turned into 3 complete word documents of over complicated instruction. He does it for EVERYTHING, so his hard assignments take 30 min just to decode.

Do NOT take this class or professor.  This class was the biggest waste of time, I'm sad to have wasted tuition on it.  This professor has an inflated sense of self esteem and every lecture (basically the exact same, repetitive concepts every week) tries to warp simple concepts such as creativity and humor into complex, meaningless breakdowns.

There is no comparison to how boring this class is. The only reason that this class is "no electronics" is so that people actually pay attention instead of having fun on their phones. However, there is an upside to this course. If you're up all night studying for a real class, you can use this class period to get a good nap in. Jorge rides a segway

I personally did not like Dr. Vanegas' class. It is all about creativity and "freeing your mind" but honestly, it's boring and I hardly ever went to class because I couldn't stand to listen to him talk (mainly) about himself and his achievements. Don't think this is an "easy A" class. I got a decent grade, but it took a lot of work to do. AVOID IT.

I personally did not like Dr. Vanegas' class. It is all about creativity and "freeing your mind" but honestly, it's boring and I hardly ever went to class because I couldn't stand to listen to him talk (mainly) about himself and his achievements. Don't think this is an "easy A" class. I got a decent grade, but it took a lot of work to do.

Vanegas' class is very tough. He tells you that immediately from the get go. His class is inspirational (be innovative, don't let anybody kill your creativity, anything is possible) but literally every lecture (online and in-class) is a variation of the SAME EXACT thing. I went to speak to him and felt like I was a burden to him. Very rude.
Don't take this class. Way too time consuming for what is suppose to be an "easy" class.

In this class a B is definitely doable. It does take quite a bit of time and effort, but no tests which is always a plus. This class is based solely off of creativity and how much work you put into the projects. My advice would be to not wait until the last minute to complete projects.
Definitely not an easy A. I worked very hard and got a B.

Tough professor, take Dr. Hill instead of this guy. It is really hard to get an A since a student has go beyond creative and time consuming on assignments. I advise you to not take this class with Dr. V. if you are taking other classes as well or if you expected this class to be easy which is NOT.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Doing the basic work in this class only gets you a C. He makes you go above and beyond to get an A. You have to "wow" him to get an A on any project. He grades off of creativity and innovation, which is something that comes naturally or doesn't. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS.
Do not take this class
He is a tough professor, take Hill instead of Dr. Vanegas

His class is hard simply because the grades are based on creativity and innovation, and its something you either have or you don't, and is very hard to grade. Doing the required work only gets you a C or B, and do get an A you have to go "above and beyond" or "wow" him as he puts it. His class is either something you love or hate, no in between.
